items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 12 at 1:03AM EST until November 13 at 1:00AM EST by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...West winds 15 to 25 kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Southeast North Carolina and Northeast South Carolina
coastal waters out 20 NM.

* WHEN...From 10 AM this morning to 1 AM EST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
